answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. The delta decay curve is applied at each close, crystal records the drop, and wander recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The attacker spends 179 dollars and 19 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
